title: Desk Reference — Annual Increase of the Independent Living Monthly Service Fee
content:
**Product:** Independent Living Residency Agreement (rental model). **Subject:** the annual increase of the contracted monthly service fee.

## When this applies

An annual increase of the monthly service fee falls due on a residency once written notice of the increase has been mailed to the resident and the proposed fee stands on the residency record as a pending increase. The fee recorded for that increase becomes the fee in effect on the residency record. The recorded fee takes effect on the date the notice period and the new-resident guarantee allow, and the second person fee is not part of the increase.

## What recording the increase does

Recording the increase replaces the contracted base monthly service fee in effect on the residency record with the recorded fee, sets the rate effective date from which that fee applies, and clears the pending increase notice amount so that no increase remains pending. The second person fee and the residency ledger are not touched; statements billed from the new effective date onward use the new fee.

## Invocation — `record_annual_increase_315a2923`

**Owner and access.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_annual_increase_315a2923` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `independent_residency_id` | The reference number of the independent living residency agreement whose fee changes, as read from the residency lookup for the customer | Text identifier |
| `monthly_service_fee` | The new contracted base monthly service fee being recorded, per calendar month; it excludes the second person fee | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `rate_effective_date` | The calendar date from which the new fee applies | YYYY-MM-DD, in the community's local date |

**Return.** On success the residency shows the new fee and its effective date, and the tool returns a receipt listing `independent_residency_id` (the agreement changed), `monthly_service_fee` (the fee now in effect, USD with 2 decimal places), `rate_effective_date` (the date it applies from, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which reads `increase_recorded` when the change was saved.

## Contract questions

**Does the tool change the second person fee?** No. Only the contracted base monthly service fee and its effective date change.

**Does the tool post a charge or a credit on the ledger?** No. The ledger is not touched.

**What does the pending increase look like afterwards?** The pending increase notice amount is cleared, so no increase remains pending on the residency record.

Illustration of a receipt (hypothetical values): a call for a residency with `monthly_service_fee` 4,180.50 and `rate_effective_date` 2027-01-01 returns that residency's reference, 4180.5 as the fee in effect, 2027-01-01 as the effective date and `increase_recorded`.
